live_definition: Failure-or-SLO counts every unsuccessful HTTP request as a violation, including fast failures; measured successful-request p95 is descriptive and excludes failed requests. Original latency-only SLO rate retained separately.
primary_unit: training seed for traces; request plan for live; budgets and episodes aggregated within units; ten paired units per dataset/profile
Holm: one family per study across datasets/profiles, comparators and primary metrics
completion_rule: Only complete predefined matrices are analyzed; failed attempts retained independently.
